Built for ETHGlobal Mumbai

Any%

A Raspberry Pi handheld in a smoke shell, with rear panels that come off and snap back on with six magnets. Pick a panel to swap it.

Rear panels

    Left Right arrow keys cycle panels

    Inside

    Compute
    Raspberry Pi 3B+
    Display
    Waveshare 5 in DSI touchscreen
    Control
    DualSense controller and touch
    Power
    10000 mAh bank in the rear bay
    Audio
    PAM8403 amp, FIT0502 speaker
    Panels
    4.0 mm plate, 0.8 mm raised logo, six 6 x 3 mm magnets
    Size

    Panel colours are the Bambu PLA Basic spools they print in. The front buttons are still fitted in the shell; the device is played with a DualSense and the touchscreen.
